_comment: Example only. Merge into ~/.claude/settings.json (user) or .claude/settings.json (project) to enable the Shadow guard. It asks before git commit/push/merge/rebase/reset --hard/clean, recursive deletes, global installs, infra destroys, destructive SQL and blanket kills, and denies piping downloaded scripts into a shell. Schema: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks
